contradictions.reason: Accepted deferral of all four .sdata2 facts and both associated links. Canonical startup and finishing code demonstrates literal consumption, not compiled pool membership, size, contents or layout. No compiled evidence supports strengthening these claims.

Accepted deferral of the three grounded finishing-collision claims. Zelda transitions to state 358 only when the helper returns exactly zero; nonzero does not invoke that conversion. The common helper returns named enum outcomes, while analogous Sheik code tests == GA_Ground. This supports preserving the numeric guard and rejecting the reversed rationale without interpreting callback labels as physical-state proof.

Accepted deferral of all four finishing-phase directional claims. Sheik's deferred callback supplies Zelda's initializer; that initializer chooses Zelda states 356/358 and installs the finishing effect callback. Zelda finishing physics, no-op IASA and finishing-effect roles therefore must not be described as the destination completion of Zelda-to-Sheik. The functionality document correctly distinguishes the two directions; the empty proposal makes no unsupported replacement.
